sections.description: Auto-generate barcodes, design label templates, manage a print queue, and add products in seconds with the mobile Quick Add workflow.
sections.changelog:
1.2.39

  • Fixed: the camera preview was invisible when scanning from the Tally tab — the camera kept running and scanning in the background with no way to close it. The preview now opens over any tab.
  • Safety: the camera now switches off automatically if its preview is ever hidden, or when the phone screen turns off or you switch apps.

1.2.38

  • New: "✕ Remove from queue (n)" button on the Products list and the product edit page, next to Add Stock / +1. It appears when the product has labels waiting and removes all of them (every size/color for variable products).
  • New: in the Tally tab, a ✕ next to each row's "🏷 n in queue" removes that size/color's waiting labels, and "✕ Remove queued labels" removes them for the whole product. Removed labels count as missing again, so they can be re-queued.
  • Only labels not yet printed are removed; printed history is kept.

1.2.37

  • New: Tally tab in Quick Add (scan-to-count). Scan any label to open its product with every size/color, its stock and the labels waiting in the print queue. Scan each item once: the size/color shows in large text with a beep, and rows turn green (all counted), orange (fewer scanned than in stock — missing labels or items) or red (more than in stock). Works with Bluetooth/USB scanners, typing, or the camera kept open between scans. Counts are kept on the device if the page is refreshed.
  • New: ✏️ edit the stock of any size/color right in the Tally list (with an "= counted" shortcut), or "Set stock to counted" for all rows at once. Every change is written to the stock log.
  • New: "Queue missing labels" adds labels for the items that weren't scanned (without queuing the same ones twice), and 🏷 queues one more label for a row.
  • Improved: Stock View shows one card per variable product with a count for each size/color, and search matches sizes/colors.
  • Fixed: scanning a size/color label on the Inventory page now records stock changes against the right product.
  • Fixed: Stock View went blank when no product had a category.

1.2.36

  • New: colors per size in Quick Add. Each size row has a color box — type one or more colors (e.g. "Red, Blue") and a line appears for each color as you type, with its own units and optional price. Saving creates one variation per size + color (e.g. "S / Red") on the store's global Color attribute (created if missing; an existing "Color" or "Colour" attribute and its colors are reused). Labels show "S / Red" with each variation's own barcode.
  • Sizes without colors still work exactly as in 1.2.35. If some sizes use colors, every size with units needs a color.

1.2.35

  • New: Quick Add "Sizes (S – XXL)" toggle for apparel. Enter units per size with +/− buttons (and an optional per-size price); saving creates a variable product with one variation per size that has stock, using the store's global "Size" attribute (created if missing; existing terms like "Medium" or "X-Large" are reused). Labels for every unit are queued straight away, each with its own barcode and the size printed on it.
  • Each size gets your SKU prefix + its ID (e.g. YKS-4141) — short enough to scan on 1.4" labels.
  • With the toggle off, Quick Add works exactly as before.

1.2.34

  • New: Variable products — "Add Stock To Print" now queues every enabled variation separately, each with its own stock count, barcode and price. "+1" and the bulk "Add to Print Queue" action add one label per variation. Simple products work exactly as before.
  • New: Variation labels print the attribute values (e.g. "Royal Blue / S") under the product name, wrapping rather than truncating so the size stays visible. The product name uses the parent name.
  • New: Variations without their own SKU get one automatically when queued (your SKU prefix + variation ID), so each prints a unique, scannable barcode. Existing SKUs are never changed.
  • New: "Variation" element in the Visual Label Designer. Existing visual layouts show the attributes in the name box until you place the new element.
  • Fixed: printing a variation with the Attributes field enabled could cause a fatal error.
  • Fixed: variable products without a parent SKU had no queue buttons on the Products list.

1.2.33

  • Fixed: Barcodes on small labels (e.g. 1.4" × 0.75") were too narrow to scan reliably. In the horizontal layout the barcode area now widens automatically (up to 72%) so every bar prints at a clean 1/150" — whole printer dots at 300 and 600 dpi.
  • Improved: Code 128 barcodes are now up to ~10% shorter — digit runs are encoded in Code Set C (two digits per character).
  • Fixed: ITF-14 barcodes had zero-width start/stop bars and could not be scanned.
  • Changed: the SKU line in the info column is skipped when the exact same value is already printed under the barcode.

1.2.32

  • Fixed: Printed barcodes no longer turn into thick, uneven blocks. Bars are now drawn at a fixed physical width (0.01" standard, which lands on whole printer dots at 203, 300 and 600 dpi) and stretch to fill the barcode box height, instead of the whole barcode being squeezed to fit. Barcodes also render with crisp edges on screen and in print preview.
  • Fixed: Print and PDF output was being shrunk to ~90% by the browser because the label sheet was wider than the paper (padding added on top of 100% width). Labels now print at true size and line up with label sheets.
  • Fixed: The template Margin setting is now actually applied (top/bottom), with columns centred on the page.
  • Changed: Barcode text under Code 128 / ITF-14 bars is now printed as crisp text below the bars. The template editor preview uses the same sizing as the printed label.

1.2.31

  • Fixed: Print and Save as PDF now render labels at the correct physical size. Chrome and Safari do not support CSS custom properties inside @page rules, so the page size was not being applied — the browser was adding its own margins and scaling down the labels, making them illegible. The @page size is now output as a literal value directly in the print page template.
  • Fixed: Visual layout labels now properly clip all absolutely-positioned elements — overflow:hidden added to the inner visual wrapper.

1.2.30

  • Fixed: Visual Label Designer preview now matches the designer canvas exactly. The label preview panel renders each element at its absolute position with the correct font size, bold, and text alignment — identical to the printed output. Previously the preview still showed the old flex layout even after applying a visual design.

1.2.29

  • New: Visual Label Designer — open the drag-and-drop canvas from the Label Template editor (🎨 Open Visual Designer button). Drag and resize Barcode, Product Name, Price, SKU, and Company Name blocks freely on a scaled canvas. Click any element to set font size, bold, and text alignment. Apply saves the layout as a new "Visual" layout type used at print time. Existing Vertical and Horizontal templates are unaffected.
  • Fixed: Price is now definitively right-aligned (display:block; width:100%) in horizontal labels.

1.2.28

  • Fixed: Label product name truncation increased from 10 to 12 characters.

1.2.27

  • Fixed: Label print — product name is now left-aligned on horizontal labels. Product name is truncated to 10 characters (with ellipsis) so it never overflows the info column.

1.2.26

  • Fixed: Label print — reduced gap between company name and barcode (tighter line-height, default padding-bottom now 0). Label outer padding tightened from 2px to 1px. Info column on horizontal labels is now right-aligned instead of centered — fits more text and looks sharper.

1.2.25

  • New: Stock View — a mobile-optimised PWA page (installable on your phone) showing all published products with name, thumbnail, and live stock count badge. Red badge for out-of-stock items. Filter by category pills and search by product name. Available under Barcode Pro → 📦 Stock View.

1.2.24

  • New: Label Template field added to the Barcode metabox on the product edit page — select which label template this product should always print with. Saved as product meta and automatically used whenever the product is added to the print queue via any method (Add Stock To Print, +1 button, or bulk action). Quick Add also persists the label template from the scanned price template so future re-queuing uses the same layout.

1.2.23

  • Fixed: Quick Add — scanning a price template barcode now correctly passes the price template's linked label template to the print queue, instead of mistakenly using the price template's own ID. Labels now always print with the layout configured on the price template.

1.2.22

  • New: Two independent queue buttons on the Products list and product metabox — "Add Stock To Print" sets the print queue to the product's current stock quantity (replacing any existing entry), and "Add to Queue +1" increments the existing queue entry by 1. Both workflows are now available side by side.

1.2.21

  • Fixed: "+Queue" button on the Products list and product metabox now sets the print queue to the product's current stock quantity (replacing any existing entry) instead of adding 1 on top of whatever was already queued. Eliminates the +1 duplicate when a product was previously added via Quick Add.

1.2.20

  • New: "Check for updates" link added to the plugin row on the Plugins page — clears the update cache immediately so WordPress sees the latest version without waiting up to 12 hours.

1.2.19

  • Fixed: Quick Add — print queue no longer shows stock_qty+1 on first add. A defensive clear before the insert ensures the queue always reflects exactly the entered unit count.

1.2.18

  • New: Label Template editor — company name now has configurable font size (6–30 px) and padding below (0–20 px). Both values are applied at print time and reflected live in the template preview.

1.2.17

  • New: Batch Create — Unique vs Same items checkbox. Unique (default) creates N products each with their own barcode. Same creates one product with N units in stock sharing a single barcode — ideal for identical goods.
  • New: Batch Create — Default Name field. The name is printed on every barcode label in the batch and pre-fills the product name.
  • New: Quick Add — Draft Inventory panel on the Scan & Publish tab. Loads all current draft products on page open; tap any row to open its completion card without scanning.

1.2.16

  • New: Units in stock field on Quick Add and Scan-to-Publish — set how many units you have when creating a product. WooCommerce stock management is enabled automatically and stock quantity is set to your entered value. The print queue also receives the same quantity so label count matches stock. Defaults to 1.

1.2.15

  • Docs: Updated readme with all features through v1.2.14, PWA instructions, multi-photo FAQ, and full changelog.

1.2.14

  • New: Quick Add and Scan-to-Publish now support up to 5 photos per product. The first photo becomes the main product image; additional photos are saved as WooCommerce gallery images. Each thumbnail can be removed individually before saving. Photos are previewed instantly from the local device before the upload completes.

1.2.13

  • New: Quick Add photo field now has two buttons — 📷 Take photo (opens camera directly) and 🖼 Upload (opens photo library). Both the Quick Add form and the Scan-to-Publish draft card have this dual option.

1.2.12

  • New: Quick Add page is now a Progressive Web App (PWA) — add it to your phone's home screen for a native app-like experience on iOS and Android. The page runs standalone (no browser UI), has a custom icon, and loads even faster.

1.2.11

  • New: Company Name field on label templates — enable the checkbox and enter your company name to have it printed at the top of every label. Each template can have its own company name or none at all.

1.2.10

  • Fixed: Print page no longer shows the WordPress admin sidebar and toolbar — it now opens as a clean standalone page.
  • New: Save as PDF button added to the print toolbar — opens the browser print dialog where you can choose Save as PDF.

1.2.9

  • New: Per-template Barcode Designer — choose symbology (Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, ITF-14), bar height, bar width, text visibility, and bar colour independently for each label template. Print queue always uses the template's own barcode settings, not the global plugin defaults.

1.2.8

  • New: Label Template editor now has a live preview with editable test data (Name, Price, SKU, Barcode) — the real barcode SVG is fetched and rendered as you type.

1.2.7

  • New: Trashing or permanently deleting a product now automatically removes it from the print queue.
  • New: Publishing a product (including via Scan-to-Publish) automatically removes it from the print queue.

1.2.6

  • New: Quick Add page now has two tabs — Scan & Publish (draft barcode scan flow) and Quick Add (price template new product form).
  • New: Category selector added to the draft Scan-to-Publish card so categories can be assigned before publishing.

1.2.5

  • Maintenance release.

1.2.4

  • Fixed: Scanning a draft product barcode in Quick Add now shows inline Complete & Publish card.

1.2.3

  • Fixed: Barcode lookup missed draft products.

1.2.2

  • New: Live camera barcode scanner.

1.2.0

  • New: Batch Create and Scan-to-Publish workflow.
